facts.fact: The NDPC, led by national commissioner Vincent Olatunji, regulates data protection under the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023.
The NDPC fined MultiChoice Nigeria N766.2 million in July 2025 for unlawful cross-border transfers and other data practices.
The NDPC fined Fidelity Bank N555.8 million in 2024 for processing personal data without informed consent and other failings.
